plan.name: Direct Microwave and Countertop Search
plan.strategy: Assume the mug might already be hot and located on a countertop or in the microwave. Check these locations first to avoid unnecessary cabinet searching.
steps: Check countertops 1 through 3 for a mug.
If a mug is found, check if it is hot. If not, proceed to the microwave.
If no mug is found on countertops, check the microwave for a hot mug.
If a hot mug is found, place it in the coffeemachine.
If no hot mug is found, search cabinets systematically starting from cabinet 1.
